_purpose: §79 v3.2b 정상 domain 재정의 사전등록 - docs/design/phase8-blue-green-preflight-incident.md §79와 동일 내용, 기계 판독용.
supersedes: model_v32/v32_manifest.json - preserved as calibration_collection_stopped, not resumed or modified

model_role_declaration.allowed: Isolation Forest detects fault-induced multivariate telemetry anomaly (CPU/memory/KV-cache trends), not all latency SLO violations
model_role_declaration.rationale: §78 confirmed survivorship bias risk when sessions are excluded from normal data purely for having t_slo
model_role_declaration.latency_ttft_features: recorded as a Phase 8+ offline ablation candidate only, NOT added to this runtime model

normal_domain_redefinition.slo_label: separate outcome field - 'clean' or 'sustained_violation' based on t_slo presence only, does not affect eligibility
normal_domain_redefinition.implementation: anomaly-detection/v3/model_v32b/domain.py classify_exclusion_reasons()/slo_label() - reclassifies existing judge_qualification() exclusion_reasons, no new judgment logic

training_registry.no_event_aware_masking: complete sessions used as-is, no window trimming around t_slo (§78 found no basis to isolate latency events with current features)

training_and_calibration_rules.feature_selection: recomputed deterministically from the 9-session v3.2b Training registry only
training_and_calibration_rules.algorithm: IsolationForest(n_estimators=100, contamination='auto', random_state=42), no hyperparameter search
training_and_calibration_rules.threshold_selection: replay.calibrate_threshold() on the new 6-session Calibration only
training_and_calibration_rules.runtime_replay_unchanged: 15s interval, consecutive=3, reset on single normal reading, cooldown=60s

false_signal_definition: a predictive signal (consecutive=3 met) during a Calibration/Holdout session counts as a false signal episode regardless of that session's SLO label - the model's declared role is fault-induced telemetry anomaly, not latency SLO prediction

stop_loss_rule_reused_from_v32_unchanged.trigger: 1 or more false signal episodes across the 6 prospective holdout sessions
on_trigger: holdout not folded into calibration/training for v3.3
record Isolation Forest has not achieved operational reliability
propose (do not execute) main-experiment framing adjustments, then stop
stop_loss_rule_reused_from_v32_unchanged.on_pass: proceed to one-time fault/load challenge evaluation

claims_scope.allowed_language: Isolation Forest detects fault-induced multivariate telemetry anomaly using CPU/memory/KV-cache trends
forbidden_language: predicts all SLO violations in advance
detects the cause of every latency spike
